panels.head: Before you click
panels.text: Write down three things you came for. The rest is noise.

panels.head: Check the model
panels.text: Doorbuster TVs and bundles can be store-only versions.

panels.head: Compare the past low
panels.text: $499.99 for Switch 2 matches 2025; it is not new.

panels.head: Buy, then stop
panels.text: Electronics may dip again on Cyber Monday, Nov 30.
